question: Should OpenClaw accept IPv4-mapped/plain IPv4 normalization inside the voice-call forwarded-header trusted-proxy gate and merge this replacement PR after exact-head checks are green?
rationale: The patch is narrow and matches the sibling media-stream invariant, but it changes the trust predicate used before provider signature verification, so maintainer intent is required for the security-boundary equivalence and proof level.

options.title: Accept narrow normalization
options.body: Treat IPv4-mapped and plain IPv4 forms of the same configured proxy as equivalent within the existing trustedProxyIPs contract once checks are green.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live reverse-proxy or provider webhook run if the socket probe, verifier output, and Testbox evidence are not enough for this boundary.

options.title: Pause for broader proxy design
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want CIDR support, stricter IP parsing, or a larger trusted-proxy contract before touching this predicate.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow normalization
recommendation.body: Treat IPv4-mapped and plain IPv4 forms of the same configured proxy as equivalent within the existing trustedProxyIPs contract once checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the replacement PR and has the strongest recent history on the affected voice-call webhook security surface.
